column1: # aontu:profile -- THE PROFILE VOCABULARY (ADR-035; ADR-038). A profile
# is a language declared as data -- its name, its indentation, its
# comment forms and the marker its generators carry -- and it is DATA
# and only data. `aontu template` and `aontu fmt` vet a --profile
# BUNDLED (the aontu/ tree, ADR-036), served under the aontu: scheme,
# pinned by `shape-hash` in both engines. The root is not type()-marked;
# a profile document STATES a profile -- the vocabulary alone has no
# EXPERIMENTAL until the distribution layer can version it by
# Every expectation was obtained by running BOTH engines and diffing.

column3: @"aontu:profile"\naontu: Lang: { lang: "ocaml", indent: { unit: " ", width: 2 }, comment: { block: { open: "(*", close: "*)" } }, template: { marker: "(*-", close: "*)", ext: ["ml", "mli"] } }
@"aontu:profile"\naontu: Lang: { lang: "python", indent: {}, ident: { case: { field: "camel" } } }
@"aontu:profile"\naontu: Lang: { lang: "python", indent: {}, template: { marker: "#-", ext: ["m l"] } }
